entities.name: Zhu Shuzhen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zhu Shuzhen was a Chinese poet who lived during the Song dynasty. She married an official with whom she had a bad marriage. She either had an affair or committed suicide. After her death, her parents burned poetry that she had written.
